verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs say users can 'secure your data with Postman Vault', which is a first-party capability for keeping sensitive data out of shared assets. The evidence is only a single overview line. The community remark about secrets being uploaded is a general warning, not a concrete counter-example to Vault, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documentation of how Vault keeps credentials out of shared collections and environments, masked or secret variable types, external vault integrations (e.g. HashiCorp, AWS, Azure), and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can keep credentials out of shared files with masked secrets or an external vault integration
